_doc: Domain packs: systems of record per industry, how agents may interact with each, and a runnable scenario. maxRisk caps what any agent may do on that system, whatever its SFIA level.

scenario.name: Tokenised asset launch
scenario.why: A tokenised product goes from idea to a tested contract.

trigger.msg: Can we launch tokenised invoice financing next quarter?

actions.summary: Write token rules and compliance requirements

items: Who can hold tokens (verified businesses only)

actions.summary: Screen pilot investor wallets
Deploy the contract to a test network
Run transfer and redemption tests

scenario.outcome: The tokenised invoice product is defined, screened and running on a test network. Mainnet deployment stays a human decision after the external audit.

scenario.name: Repayment reminders
scenario.why: Fewer missed BNPL repayments without breaking lending rules.

trigger.msg: Missed repayments are up 9%. Can we add smart reminders?

steps.handoff: Payday mismatch is the main driver

actions.summary: Analyse missed repayments by cohort
actions.result: Most misses are 1–3 days late, on payday mismatches

actions.summary: Create the reminders epic with stories

items: Offer to move date to payday (once per term)
Respect contact preferences and hardship flags

actions.summary: Confirm no conflict with hardship and monitoring rules
actions.result: No conflicts; hardship flag must suppress reminders

actions.summary: Create a test-mode webhook for upcoming payments

scenario.outcome: Smart reminders are built in test mode and approved by compliance, with hardship customers excluded. Turning them on in production needs a release approval.

trigger.msg: Let's roll out AI search to customers, carefully.

actions.summary: Create the rollout epic with success measures
Add the feature behind a flag
Turn on AI search for 10% of users
Compare search success and errors

scenario.outcome: AI search is live for 10% of users, beating its target with errors well under the guardrail. Expanding further is one approval away.

scenario.name: Reduce discharge delays
scenario.why: Patients go home sooner, without touching clinical records.

trigger.msg: Discharges after 11am are blocking beds. What's going on?

steps.handoff: Pharmacy wait is the biggest delay

actions.summary: Analyse 90 days of de-identified discharge times
actions.result: 61% of discharges after 11am; pharmacy wait is the top delay

actions.summary: Map the discharge journey with ward staff
Add discharge plans to patients' records
Write the improvement options paper

items: Medication review the day before discharge

actions.summary: Draft the change and communication plan

scenario.outcome: The main delay is pharmacy, and three options are ready for clinical review with a one-ward pilot planned. No agent wrote to the EMR: clinical changes stay with clinicians.

scenario.name: Cut late deliveries
scenario.why: On-time delivery improves through better routing.

trigger.msg: On-time delivery fell to 87% in the north region. Fix it?

actions.summary: Analyse late deliveries by route and depot
actions.result: Late loads cluster on 3 routes leaving after 2pm

actions.summary: Check depot dwell times
Model the current and future dispatch process

artefact.title: Depot 4 dispatch: current and future process

items: Move cut-off for north routes to 12:30

actions.summary: Apply new cut-offs in the test environment
Raise a change to promote the rules

scenario.outcome: Late loads were caused by afternoon departures from Depot 4. New cut-offs and pre-staging go live Monday, aiming to lift on-time delivery back above 95%.

scenario.name: Digital motor claims
scenario.why: Customers lodge motor claims online in minutes.

trigger.msg: Phone lodgement takes 25 minutes. Can we go digital for motor claims?

actions.summary: Analyse motor claim lodgement and cycle times
actions.result: 70% of motor claims are simple; lodgement averages 25 minutes

actions.summary: Prototype the online lodgement flow
Create the digital lodgement epic
Lodge 50 test claims in non-production

scenario.outcome: Online motor claim lodgement is designed, specified and tested, cutting lodgement from 25 to about 6 minutes. Real claims are never paid or declined by an agent.

scenario.name: Faster month-end close
scenario.why: Close the books in 4 days instead of 8.

trigger.msg: Month-end takes 8 days, mostly reconciliations. Help?

steps.handoff: Six suppliers cause most of the work

actions.summary: Analyse unreconciled bank lines
actions.result: 1,240 lines a month; 70% are 6 recurring suppliers

actions.summary: Create bank rules for the 6 recurring suppliers
Confirm rules keep segregation of duties
actions.result: Controls intact: rules match only; approvals unchanged

actions.summary: Update the close checklist and train the team

scenario.outcome: About 70% of reconciliations now match automatically, controls are intact, and the close drops from 8 days to a 4-day checklist. Nothing was approved, paid or lodged by an agent.

scenario.why: Community groups apply for grants in half the time.

trigger.msg: Applicants say our grants form takes 3 hours. Can we fix that?

steps.handoff: The budget section is the problem

actions.summary: Analyse drop-off and completion times
actions.result: 38% abandon at the budget section; median 3.1 hours

actions.summary: Run co-design sessions with 10 community groups

items: Replace budget table with guided questions

actions.summary: Configure the new assessment workflow in test
File the decision and design as official records

artefact.title: Grant form redesign: decision and design

scenario.outcome: The redesigned form targets the budget section that 38% of applicants abandon. It's configured for testing, and the decision is on the official record. Funding decisions stay with people.

scenario.name: Early support for at-risk students
scenario.why: Students get help before they fail, not after.

trigger.msg: First-year attrition is 18%. Can we spot students who need help earlier?

steps.task: Agree what data can be used

actions.summary: Record the approved data use and privacy conditions

items: Use LMS activity and enrolment data only

actions.summary: Analyse first 4 weeks of LMS activity
actions.result: No login in 10 days predicts 64% of withdrawals

actions.summary: Link to progression outcomes
Create advisor outreach tasks for this week's flagged students
Write the advisor playbook

scenario.outcome: A simple signal (no LMS login for 10 days) flags students early. Advisors have 212 outreach tasks and a playbook, under an approved, opt-out data agreement. No grades or enrolments were touched.

scenario.name: Faster response insight
scenario.why: Leaders see where response times slip, using approved data only.

trigger.msg: Priority 1 response times are slipping on weekends. Why?

steps.handoff: The slippage is late weekend nights

actions.summary: Analyse the de-identified response-time extract
actions.result: Weekend P1 times +3.5 minutes, between 10pm and 2am

actions.summary: Compare unit availability by shift
actions.result: Unit availability drops 22% at shift changeover at 11pm

actions.summary: Model rostering options for the changeover
Draft the trial plan and union consultation notes

scenario.outcome: Weekend P1 slippage comes from the 11pm shift changeover. Rostering options and a trial plan are ready for command. Agents used only de-identified extracts, and never touched records, evidence or dispatch.
